buildProposal.decision: Build and merge the authorized C3 two-account curated-context integration.

No fabricated admission, owner disposition, human approval or model recording. No new research execution, live product model or retrieval activation, paid routes, deployment, migrations, durable product writes, sharing, approval or outreach. Structured proposed-action bridge and account switcher remain separate later work.
